articles.title: A LatAm telecom operator is putting part of its finances on Avalanche
articles.snippet: Led by former IBM Blockchain partner Jules Miller, Iris is helping Bolivia's VIVA use stablecoins for settlement, dollar reserves and new financial services without replacing its existing telecom systems.

articles.title: Ethiopia cuts Bitcoin miners’ power by 77% amid hydropower shortage: Report
articles.snippet: Bitcoin miners generated 35% of the state-owned power producer’s revenue last year, but declining reservoir inflows led the utility to prioritize households and manufacturers.

articles.title: OpenAI's Rogue AI Agents Were Probing Hugging Face Two Months Before Hack
articles.snippet: An independent researcher found the agents hijacked Hugging Face accounts and mapped the platform's defenses as early as May 13—activity OpenAI's own incident report never fully described.

articles.title: Zuckerberg Pushes Back on Coordinated AI Slowdown, Says Labs Can Act Alone
articles.snippet: Meta’s CEO says competition and potential liability give AI developers reasons to prioritize safety, citing the company’s decision to delay Muse.

articles.title: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens
articles.snippet: Overseas firms serving UK retail customers need authorization too, and nobody trades under the new rules before October 2027.
